Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1235
Claimant:
Danielle Hahn
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
4-18-23
First notice of loss received for a low-speed head-on collision involving the insured vehicle. The claimant reports a
knee injury from the impact and is not represented by an attorney at this stage.
7-14-23
Reviewed the photos submitted with the claim. They confirm several details of the reported damage, though there are
no independent witnesses to the collision itself. The vehicle damage is consistent with the described impact.
8-26-23
Confirmed with the police report and statements from the scene that the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the
crash. The driver is named on the policy, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates coverage.
8-30-23
Spoke with the claimant again. The account of how the collision happened matched what was given in the first
contact. A few old scratches on the vehicle may predate this crash and are being noted separately from the current
damage.
11-4-23
Medical records show treatment for the knee followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved. The
reported injury fits the kind and force of a crash of this type. No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
11-25-23
File reviewed. The injury, vehicle damage, and claimant account are consistent with one another, and the claim is
ready for the next level of review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
